name: intro
heading:
Small hardware.
Specialised intelligence.
narration: Small hardware. Specialised intelligence. Meet L L M Optimise.

name: purpose
heading:
Push your hardware.
Prove the result.
narration: Explore what your hardware can really do. Balance speed, memory and cost, while keeping task quality in view.

name: configure
heading: Start with your task.
narration: Choose a model, add representative examples, and set your quality and resource limits. Start with a baseline you can measure.

name: compare
heading:
Find the measured
trade-offs.
narration: Run bounded experiments. Compare latency, memory and accuracy, then inspect the measured trade-offs before you choose a configuration.

name: explore
heading:
Make every
constraint useful.
narration: Explore context sizes, quantized caches and accelerator settings, with controlled searches and clear evidence for every result.

name: architecture
heading:
One engine.
Multiple ways to work.
narration: One shared application engine connects the visual workspace, command line and MCP interface. Python coordinates workflows, while an optional Rust supervisor manages model processes.

name: routing
heading:
Your priorities.
Your model choices.
narration: Route agents using your priorities. Calibrate on scored tasks, reuse exact responses, and unload idle models to recover memory.

name: develop
heading:
Describe. Build.
Test. Refine.
narration: Describe a solution with your chosen model. Review the changes, then build and test a disposable copy in Docker, with bounded repair loops.

name: training
heading:
Specialise smaller
models with Soup.
narration: Use Soup to train task adapters, reload them, and compare results. Keep held-out evaluations separate, so smaller models still have to prove their value.

name: mcp
heading:
Work through
your assistant.
narration: Ask the built-in assistant for guidance, or drive the laboratory from a compatible MCP client. The companion skill helps your assistant discover tools and interpret evidence.

name: evidence
heading:
Evidence you
can inspect.
narration: Validated workflows span Mac, Windows, Linux, Docker and OpenRouter. Hardware results remain specific to the model, task and configuration you test.

name: outro
heading:
Find your
better fit.
narration: Open source. MIT licensed. L L M Optimise. Find a better fit for your task, on the hardware you have.
